info.description:
**HOST-URL**: [https://kiuapi-stage.kiusys.net](https://kiuapi-stage.kiusys.net)

## Getting Started.

This guide will help you to understand and start using KIU-API-Public.

KIU-API-Public is a POST RESTful JSON API that KIU System Solutions offers exclusively for customers in order to access different functionalities known as functional groups such as "air", "smartpricing", "services" and many more (for example, "webcheckin" group of functionalities offers the options to complete a webcheckin integration tool).

To get started, we recommend you to review this documentation in order to understand how to use this product.

---

## How to Access KIU-API-Public

KIU-API access is validated through a KIU-API-Token. This token grants users access to consume JSON services of a specific segment and the assigned group of functionalities. To obtain a KIU-API-Token, customers have to request it from KIU System Solutions at [webservices@kiusys.com](https://mailto:webservices@kiusys.com).

We will reply with the customer segment and the KIU-API-Token that allows segment users to consume the APIS.

---

## Environments

KIU System Solutions offers customers a Stage environment (SandBox) for development purposes and the Production environment that will operates into the live environment.

Each environment is determined by the host URL. Users need a valid KIU-API-Token for each of them.

- **STAGE HOST**: [https://kiuapi-stage.kiusys.net](https://kiuapi-stage.kiusys.net)
    
- **PRODUCTION HOST**: [https://kiuapi.kiusys.net](https://kiuapi.kiusys.net)
    

_Note:_ _This documentation is based on Stage environment.__The Webservices support team will first create the access to Stage environment. Access to Production environment must be requested afterwards._

---

## 1 - How to Get a KIU-API-TOKEN

Customers may ask for a KIU-API-Token, e-mailing our Webservices support team at [webservices@kiusys.com](https://mailto:webservices@kiusys.com) with the following information:

- **Group of functionalities to access**: User has to inform which functional segment or group of functionalities needs to consume (see Available Functional groups below).
    
- **Application name**: User has to declare a short name of the application that will consume the KIU-API-Public (e.g. "web page", "mobile application", etc.).
    
- **User e-mail:** User has to inform a contact e-mail of the responsible for the KIU-API-Public implementation for the customer.
    

---

## 2 - Available Functional groups

KIU System Solutions offers a group of functionalities, based on business logic in order to give users the access to the correct functionalities to implement.

- **/air**: Group of services corresponding to the reservation system.
    
- **/dcs**: Group of services corresponding to the Check-in system or Departure Control System.
    
- **/smartpricing**: Group of services that combines pricing and itinerary options.
    
- **/services**: This group of functiolaties hold the complex services that perfom a transaction such as create a booking, issue tickets, issue emds, modify reservation, etc.
    

- **/miscellaneous**: This group of functionalities allows user to get the miscellaneous content such as operation origin/destination list, dates of operation for a certain origin-destination, decode Ids, etc.
    

At the time that customers are required to access, KIU System Solutions will inform the segment-name and the KIU-API-Token assigned that will be the designator name given to the customer and the functional segments decribed here will be the sub-segments.  
There are many more active APIS. This guide offers those common functionalities to create an IBE integration.

E.g.:

```
https://kiuapi-stage.kiusys.net/[customerSegment]/services/create_booking

 ```

---

## 3 - Target URL will be:

- **host**: [https://kiuapi.kiusys.net](https://kiuapi.kiusys.net) - The host URL determines the environment.
    
- **segment**: Determines the user customer and the KIU-API-Token that will be applied.
    
- **sub-segment**: Determines the functional segment whose action will be executed in a specific segment or group of services.
    

---

## 4 - Creating a POST Request

Once you have the KIU-API-Token for a specific group of functionalities (segment) you are ready to make a POST request.

- **Method**: POST - KIU-API-Public supports HTTP POST.
    
- **Content-Type**: application/json - Header - The API is a RESTful JSON.
    
- **KIU-API-Token**: \[api-token\] - Header - Valid API token obtained from KIU System Solutions.
    
- **JSON Request**: Valid JSON - Body - The JSON request to execute based on the definitions schemas.
    

```
{
  "session_id":"${session_id}",
  "carrier": "XX",
  "flight_number": "103",
  "operating_date": "17JAN",
  "departure_airport": "AEP",
  "flight_checkin_registration": "LV-KKK"
}

 ```

_cURL example:_

```
curl --location --request POST 'https://kiuapi-stage.kiusys.net/services/booking/modify_reservation_items' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--header 'KIU-API-Token: {{customer_token}}' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data-raw '{
  "session_id":"${session_id}",
  "carrier": "XX",
  "flight_number": "103",
  "operating_date": "17JAN",
  "departure_airport": "AEP",
  "flight_checkin_registration": "LV-KKK"
}'

 ```

- **Target URL** :  
    [https://kiuapi-stage.kiusys.net/[customer_segment]/dcs/flights/add_registration](https://kiuapi-stage.kiusys.net/%5Bcustomer_segment%5D/dcs/flights/add_registration)
    

**Being:**

- **Host:**[https://kiuapi-stage.kiusys.net](https://kiuapi-stage.kiusys.net)
    
- **Segment:** /\[customer_segment\]
    
- **Sub-segments:** /dcs/flights
    
- **End-point:** /add_registration
    

---

request.description:
# Functionality

This method allows user to get information of a reservation created. This method offers multiple options to retrieve.

## List of Options

There are two options: filters and extensions.

## Filters

Displays a portion of the reservation according to user´s needs. Each of them are represented in the request body by a qualifier:  
  

- **Passengers List**: this will display the passengers list of the reservation.
    - **Qualifier**: "passenger_information":"Y" (this qualifier is combinable with others).  
          
          
        _Request Example:_
        
        ```
         {
           "point_of_sale": {
             "user": "XX",
             "kiu_device_id": "AEP00XX818",
             "agent_id": "AEP00XXSM",
             "preferred_display_currency": "ARS",
             "country": "AR"
            },
           "record_locator":"ESQHBI",
           "passengers_information":"Y"
          }    
        
         ```
        
- **Itinerary Information**: this will display the itinerary information.
    - **Qualifier**: "itinerary_information":"Y" (this qualifier is combinable with others).  
          
          
        _Request Example:_
        
        ```
         {
              "point_of_sale": {
                 "user": "XX",
                 "kiu_device_id": "AEP00XX818",
                 "agent_id": "AEP00XXSM",
                 "preferred_display_currency": "ARS",
                 "country": "AR"
            },
           "record_locator":"ESQHBI",
           "itinerary_information":"Y"
         }
        
         ```
        

- **Seats Information**: this will display the seats information of the reservation.
    - **Qualifier**:"seats_information":"Y" (this qualifier is combinable with others).  
          
          
        _Request Example:_
        
        ```
         {
           "point_of_sale": {
             "user": "XX",
             "kiu_device_id": "AEP00XX818",
             "agent_id": "AEP00XXSM",
             "preferred_display_currency": "ARS",
             "country": "AR" },
           "record_locator":"ESQHBI",
           "seats_information":"Y"
         }
        
         ```
        
- **Contact List Information**: this will display the list of contacts of the reservation.
    - **Qualifier**:"contacts_information":"Y" (this qualifier is combinable with others).  
          
          
        _Request Example:_
        
        ```
         {
           "point_of_sale": {
             "user": "XX",
             "kiu_device_id": "AEP00XX818",
             "agent_id": "AEP00XXSM",
             "preferred_display_currency": "ARS",
             "country": "AR"
           },
           "record_locator":"ESQHBI",
           "contacts_information":"Y"
         }
        
         ```
        
- **Special Services List Information**: this will display the list of special services of the reservation.
    - **Qualifier**:"special_services_information":"Y" (this qualifier is combinable with others).  
          
          
        _Request Example:_
        
        ```
         {
           "point_of_sale": {
             "user": "XX",
             "kiu_device_id": "AEP00XX818",
             "agent_id": "AEP00XXSM",
             "preferred_display_currency": "ARS",
             "country": "AR"
           },
           "record_locator":"ESQHBI",
           "special_services_information":"Y"
         }
        
         ```
        
- **Tickets List**: this will display the list of tickets of the reservation.
    - **Qualifier**:"tickets_information":"Y" (this qualifier is combinable with others).  
          
          
        _Request Example:_
        
        ```
         {
             "point_of_sale": {
             "user": "XX",
             "kiu_device_id": "AEP00XX818",
             "agent_id": "AEP00XXSM",
             "preferred_display_currency": "ARS",
             "country": "AR"
           },
           "record_locator":"ESQHBI",
           "tickets_information":"Y"
         }
        
         ```

request.description:
# Functionality:

Air shopping service in Restful. This method allows user to get the complete list of lowest available itineraries with prices based on family_fares logic.

This method hold and support serveral optional qualifiers like nego_fares, TourCodes, prices based on PTC, discounts, with and without stops.

---

## _Service logic_:

This service to optimized the performance separates the full content on different "pages".  
The first round will return to consumer a shopping_id. User may send a second request invoking this shopping_id  
and will received more content until get an exception with no more content to display.

[Request Schema reference](http://xmlns-stage-new.kiusys.com/schemas/air_shopping_v2.json)

response.name: air_shopping - Success
air_shopping - Success - Tour Code

request.description:
# Functionality:

This variant of air_shopping returns more content of the previous air_shopping consumed. 
The original payload, return a shopping_id in order to get more content of the requested itinerary invoking the shopping_id

** air_shopping schema reference **

response.name: air_shopping  by Shopping_id - Error

request.description:
# Functionality:

Price_calendar is a service that offer extended content for a date window range (+/-3 days) based on declared departure date.  
The result content will be a single cheapeast available itinerary per each combination dates.

Consumer has two options of content to get.

- default_content: Service will apply the same date difference from the request of each dates combinations.
    
- full_content: Service will mixed all the departure and return dates from the dates window range. This option could affect the performance response of the service based on the quantity of options to process.
    

[Request schema reference](http://xmlns-stage-new.kiusys.com/schemas/price_calendar.json)

response.name: price_calendar - Success - 7x7
price_calendar - Success - Pricing detail
price_calendar  - Success - Full content extended

request.description:
## Functionality:

Itinerary_calendar is a service that offers extended content for a date window range (+/-3 days) based on declared departure date. The result content will be a single cheapeast available itinerary per each combination dates.

Consumer can obtain two content options. These will be determined by the value of the 'UseMatrixSearch' parameter within 'MatrixSearch':  
• "UseMatrixSearch": If the value is false, the service will apply the same date difference from the request to each date combination.  
• "UseMatrixSearch": If the value is true, the service will combine all departure and return dates within the date window range. This option could impact the service performance response based on the number of options to process.

[Request Schema reference](http://xmlns-stage-new.kiusys.com/schemas/itinerary_calendar.json)

item.description:
## Description:

This group of services allows users to consume advanced pricing based on ATPCO standards.  
Users may ask the product team for access to consume this ATPCO content. Please check with your account executive about the requirements.

## Functionality:

This group of functionalities offers service methods to obtain complex pricing and content  
data on a single request like:

- Itinerary_shop
- Price_calendar

# Description

List of methods and services split by functionality based on the KIUFARES (smartpricing) and ATPCO (advancepricing) pricing logic.
